### The Loincloth and Jars of Wine
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/loincloth-and-jars-wine
Passage: Jeremiah 13:1
Points:
- God uses physical object lessons to help His people grasp and remember spiritual truths.
- The linen loincloth represents Israel and Judah, whom God intimately bound to Himself.
- Burying the garment until it rotted warned that Judah's pride would rot away in Babylonian exile.
- Just as in Jeremiah's day, believers must heed the Lord's visible signs and warnings.

### Bible Pathway - Aug. 17, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-17-2012.html
Passage: Jeremiah 13:9-10
Points:
- A linen sash signified readiness for service and righteousness before the Lord.
- Judah's stubborn rejection of God's word made the nation useless as witnesses to the world.
- God allows periods of hardship and captivity to expose pride and idolatry.
- Believers must actively listen to God's voice and remain clothed in humility.
